dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: ...Ah, but my sister is still working at the shrine, and I promised her that I wouldn't run around. I need to wait for her so we can go home together...

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: If my sister can't find me, she'll probably worry...

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: Thank you, but I think I'll just play by myself.
